note: The commit corrects the Turkish 'year' string and supplies the missing 'week'/'weeks' timeframes (checked by the singles, describe and plurals tests) but also adds Turkish meridians and an and_word, so test_meridians_mk, which only exercises the new meridians, is left out.

Besides skipping shadowed help names, the hint now prefers the longest help option name instead of the first configured one, so the help_names0 and help_names5 cases fail on buggy code only because the unshadowed '-h' was listed first; only help_names1 shows the shadowed '-h' fault.

Besides escaping newlines in multiline help, the commit switches the whole fish completion wire format from 'type,value<TAB>help' to newline-separated type/value/help triplets with a '_' sentinel, so the test_full_complete fish cases only assert that new format for single-line items while test_fish_multiline_help_complete checks the escaped multiline help.

Besides fixing the OverflowError for very large timedeltas, the commit removes the deprecated when parameter of naturaldelta and stops computing deltas from datetime values; the only fail-to-pass test checks the overflow fault.

Besides fixing the OverflowError/ValueError crashes on inf/nan inputs, the commit changes the output for non-finite values that were already returned without error (nan/inf/-inf become NaN/+Inf/-Inf), so the tests that fail only on that new formatting are dropped.

Besides rejecting '/', '>' and '=' in xmlattr keys (the fault), the commit rewords the ValueError raised for whitespace keys, so the whitespace-separator cases, already rejected on the buggy code, fail only on the new message text and are left out.

Besides capping image nesting to stop the RecursionError, the commit adds a public max_image_depth parameter to InlineParser (with DEFAULT_MAX_IMAGE_DEPTH); both fail-to-pass tests check the recursion fault with default settings.

The missing sign prefix for {:F} is the fault (test_numbers fails on '-12.1'), while letting {:f}/{:F} match nan/inf is a new capability that test_pattern::test_numbered alone checks through the generated regex.
Besides restricting %z to strptime-valid offsets (the crash both f2p tests check), the new pattern also starts accepting a literal 'Z' offset, a new capability no f2p test covers.

Besides making comparisons with empty intervals return False, which both fail-to-pass tests check, the commit deprecates interval-to-value comparisons with a DeprecationWarning, changes the value branch of __gt__, switches iterate() to singleton comparisons and deletes the value-comparison tests.

The fault is _in_postponed_annotation treating all code as postponed under `from __future__ import annotations` (test #0); the commit also adds Python 3.14 support (deferred annotation semantics, t-string handling with the new TStringMissingPlaceholders message), and tests #1 and #2 only check the 3.14 deferred-annotation behaviour.

The RecursionError fix for large bounded repetition is checked by the testBoundedRepetitionLargeUpperBound* tests, while the new public `max` parameter of ZeroOrMore/OneOrMore (with its >0 validation) is a new capability exercised only by the test*OrMoreMax* tests.

Besides making nested_expr honour DEFAULT_WHITE_CHARS (call-time default ignore_expr, whitespace-aware strip), the consolidated content.set_parse_action now also overwrites parse actions on user-supplied content expressions, an unrelated behaviour change; all f2p tests check the whitespace fault.

Besides making rewrite() report the .env path instead of the temp file in OSErrors, the commit adds CLI handling that turns set/unset write errors into an 'Error writing env file' message with exit code 2; both tests assert the reported .env path.
